card.name: Words before cardiac or monitoring terms
card.fires_on: Linking or modifying words (spontaneous, matched, possible, continuous, of, without) that come right before a clinical noun such as conversion, placebo, rapid fluctuations or monitoring, mostly in heart-rhythm drug warnings.

modes.label: Modifier before a clinical noun
modes.description: An adjective or adverb like spontaneous, matched, possible or continuous sits right before a medical noun.
modes.example: and during<< spontaneous>> conversion of PSVT to sinus rhythm.

modes.label: Small linking word
modes.description: A short word such as of, without or a partial verb sits inside a phrase about rhythm or arrhythmia.
modes.example: sinus pause with spontaneous resumption<< of>> normal rhythm), delirium, possible

card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a medical term in heart-rhythm and drug-reaction sentences.
